name: Owens Community College
tuition_note: Public 2-year college. In-state (Ohio resident) tuition & fees ~$5,870/yr for 2024-25 (per Univstats; consistent with ~$178/credit-hour Ohio resident rate reported by CollegeTuitionCompare 2025). owens.edu official tuition page could not be fetched live due to a TLS certificate verification error; figures sourced from aggregators citing IPEDS. Owens does NOT offer on-campus housing (confirmed by NCES College Navigator 'no campus housing' and Univstats), so housing_cost is null.
